acceptance: A report after 14 days gives pull_request and merge_group runner-minutes, PR p50 feedback time, moved-job queue failures with run IDs, and local medium escapes, each against the baseline.
Either no trigger fired, or the rollback landed the same day with a link to the revert PR and a follow-up item for the cause.
The report's numbers are reproducible from pinned run IDs.
context:
Trigger (attribution, not rates): 3 or more merge_group failures of a moved job (medium-test, correctness-gate, plan-capture-gate, tpch-binary-framing) in any rolling 7-day window. Failures in jobs that were not moved (code-test, publication reconciliation, audit-sha) do not count toward the trigger.

When the trigger fires: apply the pre-authored rollback from the ci-dedupe-06 PR the same day, then investigate. Revert first; do not tune thresholds or add exceptions to keep the change.

Also track, without triggering rollback: pull_request runner-minutes, PR p50 feedback time, merge_group rebuilds caused by moved-job failures, and local medium escapes (a moved-job queue failure whose PR head passed local medium).

Guardrails: this item does not widen or narrow the moved set; a change in scope needs a new decision item. Data comes from the Actions jobs API by pinned run IDs so the report can be replayed.
description:
After ci-dedupe-06 lands, confirm the expected savings and catch any rise in queue churn early. The decision is reversible by design; this item owns the reversal.

Baseline to compare against (2026-08-23 to 2026-09-16): pull_request pr.yml 45,562 runner-minutes per 25 days; merge_group 21,585; heavy-tier merge_group failures 0 in 318 runs; typical PR feedback ~21 min.
